data.segment_title: Terrorism / Al Qaeda Threat / Security Cost
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Campbell Brown) Tight security due to the threat of an Al Qaeda terror attack, and the reopening of the Statue of Liberty in New York City for the first time since the September 11 attacks noted; scenes shown. 
 (Washington: Andrea Mitchell) Criticism of the decision to raise the terror threat level because the information is old and because the decision might have been politically motivated featured; scenes shown from Washington, DC, and New York City; additional buildings mentioned in the Al Qaeda plot listed. [Secretary of Homeland Security Tom RIDGE – responds to charges that the information is dated.] [Terrorism expert Roger CRESSEY†- says it doesn’t mean that there aren’t active cells in the US.] [Homeland security advisor Frances TOWNSEND†- comments on Al Qaeda’s planning.] [At Congressional hearings on intelligence reform, Senator Richard DURBIN†- says this has to be about 9/11 and not about a pending presidential election.] [9/11 Commissioners John LEHMAN†, Bob KERREY†- comment on the authority that a national intelligence director should have.] Terror arrests in Britain & Pakistan noted. 
 (Studio: Campbell Brown) Report introduced. 
 (New York: Anne Thompson) The cost of increased security in response to the terror threat featured. [Trucker Jay RYAN‡- cites the problem of added time for searches.] [Brookings Institution Peter ORSZAG††- explains the security tax on the economy.] [Security consultant Michael HERSHMAN††- estimates the cost for one of the targeted sites.] [Security barrier salesman Bob HASTINGS – points out his products.]

data.segment_title: Defending America: How Safe? How Soon? (Part II)
data.segment_description: (Studio: Campbell Brown) Special series about the recommendations of the 9/11 Commission continued.   (Washington: Pete Williams) Concerns that some of the intelligence reforms could cut back on basic American freedoms examined; examples cited. [Electronic Privacy Information Center David SOBEL††- worries about the recommendation for federal standards for birth certificates & driver’s licenses.] [ACLU Anthony ROMERO††- cites concern about passenger screening & no-fly lists; worries that a government board to ensure the protection of civil liberties would shut down dissent.]

(Studio: Campbell Brown) Report introduced.   (Beloit: Wisconsin: Carl Quintanilla) Senator John Kerry’s lack of a post-convention bounce examined; details given of his new campaign focus on Iraq and the war on terror, issues in which President Bush still leads in polls. [Monday, KERRY – criticizes Bush for not having a sense of urgency about dealing with intelligence reforms.] [Democratic pollster Anna GREENBERG††, Republican pollster Jon McHENRY†- offer differing opinions on why Kerry’s numbers did not go up.] [Representative Richard GEPHARDT – says we’re pleased.]

data.segment_description:
(Studio: Campbell Brown) The deaths of US troops & Iraqi security forces in attacks in Iraq reported. 
 (New York: Jim Miklaszewski) The views of retired Gen. Tommy Franks on the situation in Iraq presented; details given from his book, “American Soldier.” [FRANKS – relates the successful tactic of baiting Iraqi President Saddam Hussein with false invasion plans; comments on being warned by Jordan's King Abdullah & Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak that Saddam had weapons of mass destruction; talks about the lack of available funding for the war; says Al Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden is a worthy adversary; relates his frustration with Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld; says the decision {to go to war} was a good one.]

New York, New York / Statue of Liberty
data.segment_description: (Studio: Campbell Brown) Report introduced.   (New York: Tom Costello) The reopening of the Statue of Liberty in New York City for the first time since the September 11 attacks featured; scenes shown of the ceremonies & the new museum; details given of security measures in response to an Al Qaeda terror threat and of the investigation into how improvement money was spent. [VISITOR – comments.] [New York Governor George PATAKI†- talks about the significance of the statue.] [Statue of Liberty superintendent Cynthia GARRETT†- says the challenge is to protect this icon while protecting those who make the pilgrimage here.] [Interior Secretary Gale NORTON†- comments.]
